messages:
Lena (social): Quick sync — we need a tight social plan around the May benchmark webinar. Focus: X + LinkedIn. Need assets, CTAs, routing.

Sam (content): Goal? signups, demo requests, or downloads? Also tone: technical or product-friendly?

Priya (product): Primary = qualified demo requests. Secondary = webinar signups. Tone: product-forward but keep bench stat simple for broad reach.

Lena (social): Proposed cadence: Teaser (48h), Stat card (24h), Registration reminder (12h), 1h reminder, Post recap + download.

Diego (design): I can deliver: 16:9 speaker clip (30s), 15s vertical cut, hero stat PNG, 3 quote cards. ETA: Tue EOD. Will include alt text.

Lena (social): Perfect. Need copy variants: 280-char X, short LinkedIn, long LinkedIn. Also want two CTAs for A/B: register vs download.

Sam (content): Draft copy (short X): "Webinar May 6: how we cut inference unit cost by 30% while improving p95. Register: https://redwood.ai/register?utm=webinar_may6 #LLM"

Sam (content): LinkedIn short: "Benchmark: 30% lower inference unit cost, 2x p95 throughput. Join our May 6 webinar to see tradeoffs and results. Register: https://redwood.ai/register?utm=webinar_may6"

Priya (product): Speakers: Priya Rao (Product) + Daniel Kim (Infra). Add one-sentence bio for each on LinkedIn long.

Rosa (sdr): Routing: tag leads with "webinar_may6". Attendees -> SDR queue "inbound-webinar". Demo CTA -> enterprise SDRs. I'll provide exact CRM mapping.

Lena (social): Good. Ops question: can marketing ops create the LinkedIn lead-gen form with hidden utm fields? @Sam or @Priya to confirm.

Priya (product): I'll ask ops. We should include hidden utm_region (us/eu) and funnel_type (register/download).

Lena (social): Timing draft (US-first):
- Mon May 4 10:00 PT: Teaser X + LinkedIn short
- Tue May 5 11:30 PT: Stat hero card X + LinkedIn short (EU boost 16:00 CET)
- Wed May 6 08:00 PT: Registration thread + LinkedIn long
- Wed May 6 10:00 PT: 1h reminder X
- Thu May 7 09:00 PT: Post recap + download link

Diego (design): I'll attach Figma link and upload PNGs. Colors: warm gradient, clear bold stat. Will include 15s vertical.

Sam (content): CTA mapping: A = register (/register?utm=webinar_may6), B = download (/download?utm=benchmark_may6). We'll A/B across channels.

Lena (social): Variant plan: X primary = A, LinkedIn primary = B for one adset. Schedule will note variant tags.

OpsBot: Suggested post windows: 10:00 PT, 11:30 PT, 16:00 CET. Scheduling draft saved as "may6_social_plan".

Rosa (sdr): Post-webinar follow-ups:
1) Attended + high interest = same-day SDR outreach.
2) Registered no-show = nurture email + on-demand link, SDR 3-day follow.
3) Download-only = score and nurture.
I'll upload routing doc.

Lena (social): Community mgmt: I'll prepare two canned replies for pricing and private deploy questions and a short engagement script for replies within 2 hours of post.

Sam (content): Minor copy edit: swap "per-token" -> "inference unit" for clarity. Also add hashtag set: #inference #LLM #MLOps for X.

Diego (design): Uploaded initial assets to Figma: https://figma.com/s/redwood/may6_assets. Will replace with final PNGs Tue EOD.

Lena (social): Next steps: Diego final assets -> Sam final copy -> Ops creates form with hidden fields -> I build scheduling sheet and request approvals by Tue 17:00 PT.

Priya (product): Approved on speakers and core stat. Ping me for the speaker blurbs.

Lena (social): Great — assembling scheduling doc now. Will tag for approvals when ready. Thanks team :raised_hands:

OpsBot: Reminder created: "Approve webinar social package" Tue 17:00 PT in #marketing.
